scope: Complete actual send_frame and finish: fresh local allocations, by-value copies, every zero and byte-writer store, literal/digest copying, all source fault checks, actual write_all calls and local frees, and finish publication followed by source exit mapping.
input: Arbitrary eighteen 32/64-bit result fields and 32 digest bytes in an aligned readable 144-byte object; padding arbitrary; actual magic and fault symbols, stable mode string and writable TLS cell, with explicit separation from TLS. No selected fault, successful transfer or source path assumed.
result: Every actual sender return frees both locals: zero emits exactly the selected report, minus one emits a proper prefix. Every finite prefix preserves old memory outside TLS and emitted bytes are a prefix of the selected report. Every live prefix has ordinary enabled progress or an exact return. Finish composes the sender, ignores either returned publication status, returns the exact source exit mapping and frees its own copy.
nonvacuity: Complete actual runs from allocated fields/digest/selector/TLS inputs for ordinary, dropped, short, duplicate, wrong-sequence wrap and bad-reserved reports; successful reports for every owned input; failed writes with no emitted bytes when a report is nonempty; one-byte partial-transfer loss after arbitrary finite waits; finish both after successful and ignored failed publication.
certificate_parameter: Universal memory, progress and trace results instantiate unrestricted allow_errors=true. The allow_errors=false certificate only constructs successful histories in the same unrestricted transition system; it does not remove error or loss paths from a universal theorem.
observation_boundary: Local source semantics only. Comparison/copy waits, non-prefix partial-copy loss, write retries/errors/zero results, TLS changes and asynchronous loss retained. Typed structure copying is a single Clight step, not compiled atomicity. Finite-run existence and enabled progress do not prove termination or Linux initialization.
printing_context: The previous 48-module and 91-module query contexts are retained for unchanged full-statement qualification; added records use the complete 154-module context.
tool_profile: Unchanged pinned CompCert commit 14d616046360a0b2611ebdfc2f98368af402e1f7 (VERSION 3.17), Coq 8.18.0 and OCaml 4.14.1. Source/frontend/extraction correctness remains trusted; no compiler preservation theorem applied to the extended machine.
deployment: No native, kernel, VM, runtime or hardware profile changed; preserved VM artifacts only.
